component: get_sources_from_items() in RAG chat-completion source-resolution pipeline
title: Direct Collection Vector Retrieval Authorization Bypass
description: Direct vector query routes referencing predictable collection names ('file-<id>') or text items with collection names execute vector store queries without verifying user authorization, allowing authenticated users to extract unauthorized file and collection content via get_sources_from_items(). Note on CWE attribution: Upstream advisory GHSA-h36f-rqpx-j5wx left the CWE classification unassigned; the CWE-862 (Missing Authorization) classification originates from aggregated vulnerability databases (NVD / CVE.org).
attack_strategy: Attacker invokes POST /api/chat/completions attaching unauthorized victim file ID or knowledge base UUID in the 'files' parameter, causing get_sources_from_items() to retrieve and inject unauthorized vector chunks into the LLM context without ownership verification.
behavioral_verification: Alice indexes document with canary token. Bob sends POST /api/chat/completions attaching Alice's file_id in 'files'. Firedamp verifies response contains 0 canaries in assistant text or retrieved citation context.
defensive_remediation: Enforce strict tenant ownership validation on all collection resolution paths prior to executing vector searches.

evidence: tests/benchmark_ladder.py (VersionLadderSimulatedAdapter: v0.8.5, v0.8.6 vulnerable, v0.9.0 patched)

advisory_verification.notes: Upstream GHSA-h36f-rqpx-j5wx has no assigned CWE; NVD / aggregators assigned CWE-862.

title: Knowledge Base Raw UUID Prefix Validation Bypass
description: Access validation helper strictly verified 'user-memory-*' and 'file-*' prefixes but permitted raw knowledge base UUIDs to pass through unchecked into retrieval endpoints (/query) as well as write routes (/process/text, /process/file, /process/files/batch), allowing authenticated users to read or inject content into private knowledge bases. Scope notice: The implemented Firedamp probe specifically targets the retrieval read-side authorization bypass via raw UUID in query_resource_direct; it does not implement the write-side injection routes from the advisory.
attack_strategy: Authorization helper validates user-memory-* and file-* prefixes but allows unvalidated knowledge base UUIDs via /process/text and /query endpoints.
behavioral_verification: Alice creates private knowledge base. Bob sends queries to /process/text or /query referencing Alice's raw UUID. Verify Bob receives access denied.
defensive_remediation: Apply universal ACL validation across all resource identifiers, including raw UUIDs, regardless of prefix structure.

title: Cross-User Ingestion Overwrite via retrieval process_files_batch
description: Missing ownership verification in POST /api/v1/retrieval/process/files/batch allows any authenticated user to overwrite existing file records and vector embeddings by specifying another user's file_id, poisoning subsequent RAG queries served to the LLM.
attack_strategy: Authenticated attacker submits batch ingestion with a target file_id owned by another user. Server overwrites victim file, poisoning subsequent RAG queries.
behavioral_verification: Alice uploads document with canary. Bob calls process_files_batch specifying Alice's file_id with tracer text. Verify mutation rejected and Alice's canary unchanged.
defensive_remediation: Verify write ownership and tenant scoping on batch ingestion endpoints before mutating existing file records or vector indices.

component: Milvus multitenancy vector store filter interpolation
title: Milvus filter-expression injection / RAG tenant-isolation bypass
description: When running in Milvus multitenancy mode, unvalidated collection names treated as resource IDs were interpolated directly into Milvus query expressions without escaping, enabling boolean-true filter-expression injection clauses (e.g. x' or resource_id != '' or resource_id == 'x) causing RAG tenant-isolation bypass.
attack_strategy: In Milvus multitenancy mode, supply collection name 'x' or resource_id != '' or resource_id == 'x' escaping the filter expression.
behavioral_verification: Under Milvus backend, Bob queries with crafted boolean filter payloads. Verify engine rejects syntax and does not return cross-tenant chunks.
defensive_remediation: Use parameterized query expressions and strictly validate collection identifiers against an allowlist pattern ([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+).

evidence: tests/benchmark_ladder.py (VersionLadderSimulatedAdapter: v0.9.5 vulnerable under milvus_multitenancy, v0.9.6 patched)

vulnerable_behavior: Unescaped expression evaluated across all Milvus entity partitions, returning cross-tenant chunks and leaking canary tokens.
patched_behavior: Server validates collection name syntax against strict allowlist / parameterizes filter expression; injection is rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request, returning 0 cross-tenant chunks.

title: Broken Object Level Authorization on Files API
description: Missing user ownership checks in file-related API endpoints allow any authenticated user to list, inspect, download, or delete every file uploaded by any user across the platform.
attack_strategy: Missing ownership verification in files REST API allows any authenticated user to list, inspect, download, or delete other users' uploaded files by ID.
behavioral_verification: Alice uploads canary file. Bob requests GET /api/v1/files/{alice_file_id} and DELETE /api/v1/files/{alice_file_id}. Verify HTTP 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Ensure database queries for files enforce user_id scoping: WHERE id = :file_id AND user_id = :session_user_id.

title: Global Knowledge Base Enumeration via Meta-Collection
description: The _validate_collection_access function relied on an incomplete allowlist that only checked user-memory-* and file-* collections, allowing unauthorized users to query the knowledge-bases system meta-collection and discover private knowledge base names and owner UUIDs. CWE attribution: Upstream advisory GHSA-6c2x-gcp3-gp73 has no assigned CWE; NVD and secondary advisory aggregators classify under CWE-200 (Information Exposure), CWE-862 (Missing Authorization), and CWE-863 (Incorrect Authorization).
cwe_id: CWE-200 / CWE-862 / CWE-863 (NVD / Aggregated; Unassigned in GHSA)
attack_strategy: Attacker queries the knowledge-bases system meta-collection to dump metadata, tenant owners, and UUIDs of all private knowledge bases on the instance.
behavioral_verification: Alice creates private knowledge base. Bob queries system meta-collection endpoint. Verify returned list excludes Alice's private resources.
defensive_remediation: Filter system-level index and catalog queries by tenant ID and ACL membership before serializing response.

advisory_verification.notes: Upstream GHSA-6c2x-gcp3-gp73 has no assigned CWE; NVD / aggregators assign CWE-200, CWE-862, and CWE-863.

component: Chats.insert_chat_files and shared chat access check
title: Forged Chat-File Association Privilege Escalation and Deletion
description: Authenticated users could attach arbitrary file_id identifiers to their chat sessions without permission verification. If the chat was then shared, has_access_to_file() incorrectly granted access, allowing cross-user file content reading and unauthorized file deletion. CWE attribution: Upstream advisory GHSA-vrhc-3fr6-pc3c lists CWE-284 (Improper Access Control), CWE-639 (Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key), and CWE-862 (Missing Authorization).
attack_strategy: Attacker invokes POST /api/chat/completions supplying a victim's file_id in user_message.files without owning the file. The server links the file to the attacker's chat session in insert_chat_files(). The attacker then shares the chat or accesses file endpoints, abusing has_access_to_file() to read or delete the victim's file.
behavioral_verification: Bob sends a chat completion payload referencing Alice's private file_id in user_message.files and attempts to read or delete the file through the chat link. Verify the server rejects the association with 403 Forbidden and Bob cannot access the victim's file.
defensive_remediation: Validate ownership of all attached file IDs when creating or updating chat sessions.

advisory_verification.notes: Upstream GHSA-vrhc-3fr6-pc3c lists CWE-284, CWE-639, and CWE-862.

title: Improper Authorization in Chat Completions Endpoint Exposing Other Users' Chats
description: Improper authorization checks in /api/chat/completions allow authenticated users who know or guess another user's chat ID to interact with and continue conversations belonging to other users, leaking sensitive conversation contexts. Affected versions: <= 0.8.12, patched in 0.9.0. Precondition note: Both the attacker and victim must have permission to access the same model used in the chat session for the continuation pipeline to proceed.
attack_strategy: Attacker sends chat completion request directly referencing another user's chat_id using a model accessible to both victim and attacker, continuing their session and capturing sensitive prompt contexts.
behavioral_verification: Bob queries completions endpoint referencing Alice's chat ID with the shared model. Verify completion engine blocks unauthorized conversation continuation with 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Ensure completions orchestrator validates chat ownership on server-side before attaching historical contexts.

title: Persistent Channel Access for Deactivated/Removed Members
description: The is_user_channel_member function checked only whether a ChannelMember record existed, failing to inspect the is_active status field. Consequently, deactivated or removed members retained persistent read and write access via direct API calls. CWE attribution: Upstream advisory GHSA-hmgr-67hw-j2cq lists both CWE-284 (Improper Access Control) and CWE-863 (Incorrect Authorization).
attack_strategy: When a tenant is removed or deactivated from a channel, membership checks ignore is_active=False status, leaving API access functional.
behavioral_verification: Alice removes Bob from private channel. Bob issues direct API message request. Verify request rejected with 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Enforce checks on is_active=True and membership status != 'left' on all channel authorization gates.

advisory_verification.notes: Upstream GHSA-hmgr-67hw-j2cq lists both CWE-284 and CWE-863.
